hints.title: Recursive Parentheses Scope
hints.text: Expressions inside nested parentheses can be evaluated independently as subproblems.

hints.title: Closing Delimiter Base Case
hints.text: Treat parentheses recursively, returning the evaluated integer when a closing parenthesis is reached.

hints.title: Operator Precedence and Accumulation
hints.text: Use recursion or a parsing container to accumulate terms, evaluating multiplication and division eagerly while deferring addition and subtraction until the current scope closes.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of mathematical expression string
complexity.notes: Single pass recursive descent parser with integer truncation toward zero.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating left-to-right without operator precedence violates standard arithmetic rules.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stack frames and pending terms use O(N) memory in the worst case of deeply nested parentheses.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly implement integer division truncating toward zero (int(a / b) in Python).
